digest.component_or_area: LLM plan-review gate logic (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability criteria)
propositions: Four overlay and leaf-routed criteria (T13, T14, removal-rationale, asserted-capability) produced zero findings across ~7900 agentic runs due to absent pre-filtering vocabulary.

Deterministic pre-gate rules using regex conjunction (text_all), file-impact glob matching, and file-impact reason patterns must skip criteria only when subject vocabulary is entirely absent, preserving LLM router authority for fired plans.
Gate skips must be recorded in coverage.routing.det_gated keyed by criterion id with rule name, visible in REVIEW_RESULT sidecar, with duplicate suppression at re-route step (_project_criteria).
Existing T5a/T5d/T7/T12 overlay triggers must migrate to DetGateRule objects as one-element text_all rules with identical fire/no-fire behavior on representative texts.
